acceptance: The original DONE WHEN is met for an actual bleaching series using the ratio method: the corrected background-subtracted trend is flat and the corrected intensities and method are recorded.

archived_real_series.dataset: Cell Tracking Challenge Fluo-N2DL-HeLa H2B-GFP, two 92-frame movies
archived_real_series.method: ratio with Measure's local ring-background columns
archived_real_series.result: Signal above background fell to 0.61 of its start before correction. After correction, last/first was 0.99 in movie 1 and 1.01 in movie 2; maximum deviation was 1.9% and 3%, respectively. Mitotic-nucleus brightening relative to the frame median was retained.
archived_real_series.note: These are the archived 2026-09-30 numbers; the scratch movie was not rerun today.
